name: Harberton & Vale Bank

ring.prompt: Thank you for calling Harberton and Vale Bank. Calls are recorded for security and training. You are currently sixth in the queue.

menu.prompt: For online and mobile banking, press one. For payments and transfers, press two. For mortgages, press three. For bereavement and estate services, press four.
menu.wrongKeyPrompt: I'm sorry, that wasn't one of the options. Let's try that again.

holdAnnouncement: All of our advisers are helping other customers. Please stay on the line and we'll be with you as soon as we can.

clerk.greeting: Estates team, this is Marcus. Firstly, I'm very sorry for your loss. May I start with the full name of the customer who has passed away?

turns.reprompt: I do apologise — could you give me the full name once more, and spell the surname for me?

turns.say: Thank you. And what date did they pass away?
turns.reprompt: Sorry, the line dipped there — the date of death again, please?

turns.say: Nearly done. Can I take your own name, and your relationship to the customer?
turns.reprompt: Sorry — just your name, and how you're related to the customer?

outcome.closing: That's all registered and the accounts are now flagged with our estates team. Your reference is {REF}. Once we've seen the death certificate we'll write to the executor with the closing balances. Take care now.

quirk: Full three-step verification — name, date, then caller details — but a clean green path throughout.
